title: Core: AS2 string escape sequences and unicode
description: Verify AS2 string literals with escape sequences compile: '\n', '\t', '\r', '\\', '\'', '\"', '\0', unicode escape '\u0041'. Also verify string comparison operators: ==, !=, <, >, <=, >= on string values. Tests in packages/core/src/as2/__tests__/stringliterals.test.ts.
